title: Pointless features and connection/access issues
summary: This topic combines a few clear complaints about Bluetooth auto-connect and awkward door access with many fragments that mention something feeling pointless or not working but lack enough context to identify a single consistent issue.

negative.summary: Negative feedback points to Bluetooth not automatically connecting and a door-access interaction that feels awkward and pointless when approaching with full hands.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention features or situations described as pointless, dissatisfaction that is not explained, and isolated references to foot detection or acceptance without enough context to summarize them as a single issue.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too brief to identify the exact feature or problem being discussed.
